corrections.GSE190604_is_not_this_study: GSE190604 is Schmidt/Steinhart 2022 primary T-cell CRISPRa/i Perturb-seq, not Replogle 2022. The previous catalogue entry was misidentified.
corrections.harmonizome_note: Harmonizome reports 7189 perturbation sets for this study, but its signature list is a filtered/derived subset and should not be treated as the authoritative target inventory. The h5ad obs index is authoritative.

dataset.title: Mapping information-rich genotype-phenotype landscapes with genome-scale Perturb-seq

honest_negative_guard.note: No honest-negative trigger is pulled on this dataset. Preprocessing completed without degeneracy: 200 observational rows, 7 consultable and 3 held-out interventions. If the Stage 4 model run reveals that the 10 consultable genes collapse to fewer independent perturbation conditions or that controls are degenerate, the diagnostic must be updated and the verdict reconsidered.

intervention_coverage.note: Every observable locked gene also has at least one CRISPRi guide in the obs index. ADGRB1 and BCL2 are absent from both the expression matrix and the perturbation target list.

leak_probe_outputs.note: Both stub and real-LLM leak-probes passed. A real leak-probe must remain passed before any Stage 4 real-data model run can claim MET.

real_backend.note: Re-run after spec model_lock correction to kimi-k2-0711-preview. The model returned empty dataset_guess, pathway_guess, and gene_mapping for all seeds.

steps: Subset the bulk matrix to the 10 consultable locked genes plus strong co-varying candidates selected by a locked pre-processing rule.
Build observation rows: one per perturbation target (including NON-TARGETING controls).
Label each row with the perturbed gene symbol and mark controls.
Run distribution checks and leakage-probe on the target list before model fitting.
Feed the resulting (X, intervention, control) tuples into the strong-locus Stage 4 causal-discovery harness.

reason: 10 of 12 locked p53-pathway genes are both measured and perturbed in Replogle 2022 K562 genome-wide Perturb-seq, exceeding the >=5 consultable-intervention threshold. The 2 missing genes (ADGRB1, BCL2) are not in the expression matrix and therefore cannot be rescued by requesting additional guides.

stage4_harness_run.root_cause: The Replogle 2022 pseudo-bulk h5ad provides at most 1-2 aggregated observations per held-out perturbation target. With the locked SEM effect threshold of 1.5, no held-out intervention produces a standardized mean shift large enough to declare an empirical true edge. The strongest observed standardized mean shifts are ~1.2-1.4 (BAX->CASP3, AIFM2->BBC3).

variable_selection_lock.selection_rule: Within the locked KEGG pathway, take the first N gene symbols by alphabetical order. Skip any gene not present in the dataset. The final list is fixed; no post-hoc additions or removals to improve scores.
